## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 123 image captures during March 2025. This report summarises activity at the site for the month, including the number of captures submitted for grading and the subsequent grading outcomes. The activity total provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 123 captures, 3 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. Ungradable images could not be assessed for grading purposes and are reported separately from images that received a grading outcome. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 19 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. The referable result count and median lag are reported for the month of March 2025. Together, these measures provide a concise summary of grading outcomes and the time taken for results to progress through the grading process at Oakridge Primary Care.
